characters.name: Mãe do Kael
characters.prompt: Create ONE original character model sheet for Soulmonsters, exactly matching the CLEAN SIMPLE 2D MANGA DRAWING STYLE and restrained treatment of IMAGE 1. Image1 is STYLE AND SHEET LAYOUT only, Image2 is IDENTITY ONLY; do NOT copy image2's big chibi head, thick outline, textured rendering or lighting. It is NOT pixel art and NOT a sprite sheet. Match Kael's delicate thin dark line, soft angular anime face and chin, modest oval eyes, simple nose/mouth, clean hair masses, long clean limbs, low detail folds, flat slightly muted local colors, one discreet hard cel-shadow tone. No volumetric painting, gradients, realism, 3D, poster effects, texture or chunky cartoon proportions. Preserve the target person's skin color, hair silhouette, clothes, belongings and age. Youths about5.5 heads tall, adults about6heads, same elegant manga vocabulary. Adult characters must visibly read as adults, not aged-up Kael clones. White background. Landscape1536x1024, airy consistent layout like image1: LEFT half has two large complete full-body drawings at same scale, front3/4 then back3/4, standing naturally with shoes fully visible, no overlap, full margins. RIGHT half has exactly FOUR busts in a clean2x2 arrangement: colored speaking/happy, colored focused/determined, colored surprised/concerned, then a delicate UNCOLORED pencil/line-art calm bust. Each bust has complete head/hair, enough collar to recognize costume. Same face, hairstyle, outfit and accessory placement across all views and portraits. Small handwritten character name at upper left only. No extra labels, no logos, no watermark, no background props. Hands anatomically clear, normal size footwear. Strong simple silhouette without microdetail. Text must read exactly: "Mãe do Kael". Target identity: Adult Brazilian woman, warm medium tan skin, brown eyes, navy-black wavy hair pinned in a high loose bun with two curled side locks. Teal puff-short-sleeved blouse, coral-red calf-length wrap skirt with side knot, flat brown sandals. No held item. Warm mature mother, not a child. Mature mother around40, warm and capable, slightly rounded adult face and gentle lower eyelid, subtle smile lines, no teen face or toddler proportions. Hair is NAVY BLACK, blouse TEAL, skirt CORAL calf-length wrap with knot at her LEFT waist (viewer RIGHT front, viewer LEFT back), flat brown sandals. Feminine everyday clothes, NOT a lab coat, not a new apron. Name 'Mãe do Kael'.
